rows.independence: Reviewer implemented no Kansas packet, source or guidance change. VF67 asserted before artifact read. Review began after the scoped family central jobs passed. All 120 scoped original pages were actually inspected; independent source/output glyph and vector measurements are separate from builder reports. Only review evidence/native return written.

ROUTE_IDENTITY.finding: Exact family, route key, statutory branch and legal name agree across the frozen source receipt, map, guide, governed track and original pages. No other Kansas route or specialty packet is accepted.

SOURCE_IDENTITY.finding: Independently hashed all six held official sources: current 10/14/2025 criminal cover sheet, 08/2022 petition and granting order, and 12/2016 notice, KBI cover and denial order. All 17 official pages retain source glyphs and vector paths. Current owner attestation resolves the historical KJC permission hold without waiving review.

COMPONENT_SET.finding: Each 20-page fixture contains all seven governed components: criminal cover (1), petition (6), hearing notice (1), KBI order cover (1), proposed granting order (5), proposed denial order (3), and hearing guidance (3). Participant case/support records are explicit handoffs, not fabricated attachments.

KNOWN_PREFILLS.finding: FAIL: 82/82 actual text writes independently match full fixture facts, but four required neutral order birth-year occurrences are blank: pages 10 and 15 in each fixture. Intake DOB and participant.birth_year already provide 1988 and 1979. Source widgets contain no added glyph or vector ink; original PNGs visibly confirm. These omissions are not protected judicial decisions.

REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.finding: FAIL: all 53 declared required labels and instructions are disclosed, but both order birth-year handbacks falsely say the platform has no value and ask the participant to copy an already known fact. The component descriptions also inaccurately say only captions are filled despite neutral body identity writes.

ROUTE_OPTIONS.finding: Conviction head selection and Option A are visibly marked once per fixture. Diversion head, Option B, all waiting-period choices and coercion assertion are unselected. The exact head-selection defect in the old conviction FAIL is disproven for these bytes.

REPEATING_ROWS.finding: Repeated known name, district, county, case and contact fields match complete fixture facts. Alias rows explicitly allow none and additional source rows remain available; no participant collection rows are invented, silently dropped or truncated. The separately counted repeated birth-year omission is scored under KNOWN_PREFILLS.

PROTECTED_FIELDS.finding: Independently compared glyph and vector ink in all 374 refused widget occurrences: zero added ink. Signatures, clerk service, hearing settings, judicial appearance/finding/grant-denial controls and denial reasons remain blank. 4 intended participant/route controls have actual diagonal marks; source form controls were not redrawn or silently selected.

ARTIFACTS.finding: Independently verified both exact pinned PDFs against immutable packet commit and central embedded verdict, all 40 original page PNG hashes/lengths/dimensions, original ZIP API digest and custody proof. All 40 pages actually viewed. The family job passed; overall workflow failure belongs to excluded specialty. Raw null coverage flag remains unchanged, while exact native two-document complete coverage is measured independently.

PAGE_ORDER.finding: Canonical and boundary each contain all 20 sequential original pages in the expected seven-component order. No missing, substituted, duplicate, blank or orphan final pages observed. All 40 originals have explicit measured page coverage.

CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.finding: All 82 text writes are visible and fit measured source widget geometry, including full boundary name, street/unit, city/ZIP, email and case number. All source glyphs and vector paths persist; no unexplained added ink or source masking measured on 34 official pages. All 40 original pages actually inspected, including custom guidance pages; no clipping or overlap observed.

FILING_DESTINATION.finding: Guide directs filing with the district-court clerk in the original criminal action and includes the criminal cover sheet, copy-count confirmation and a stop when arrest and convicting counties differ. Known original case number is retained without asserting a new court-assigned docket.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.finding: Full guide and current custom pages preserve governed $176 docket fee, authorized personnel charge not exceeding $19, and clerk confirmation. No general poverty waiver is fabricated; specialty waiver is kept separate from these three routes.

SERVICE.finding: Original hearing notice contains the clerk/deputy-clerk certificate; every certificate/service fact/signature remains blank. Guide assigns hearing and notice to court/clerk, requires participant notice/copies, and expressly forbids participant service or signing the clerk certificate. No completed service is asserted.

SELF_HELP_STOP.finding: Every governed stop condition is present in the frozen guide: opposition/contested hearing, disputed classification, registration, pre-2011 comparability, discretionary findings, felony/firearms, immigration and differing counties. Diversion adds unfulfilled/uncertain fulfilment and wrong-disposition stops; coercion adds contested assertion, trafficking-remedy referral and individualized-advocacy limits. No eligibility determination or fabricated account is delivered.

nineCounters.countingNotes: Four known required birth-year field occurrences per family (two fields times two fixtures). Existing DOB is collected, so requiredFactsNotCollected is zero. Semantic handback errors are scored explicitly even when labels physically exist. No builder zero counter was used as proof.

rasterEvidence.coverageBasis: Two exact current native documents with all 20 sequential pages each; hashes match immutable packet commit and central original verdict. Raw null flag preserved. Failed specialty-court job excluded.

historicalFailureDisposition.specificDisposition: Old conviction opening-control FAIL is disproven only for these exact current marked bytes. Historical VF67 corrections and NOT_MEASURABLE_HERE results remain preserved; current glyph/vector/full-original inspection supplies genuinely independent measurements. No historical failed packet is declared accepted: the current family remains FAIL_REPAIR_REQUIRED on known birth-year omissions and incorrect handback semantics.
